identity.name: Re-Cell Technology Solutions
identity.aesthetic: Dark Luxury, Gold Accents, Geometric Precision

headings.usage: Use for all section titles, hero text, and card headings. Tracking tight.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, labels, and data tables. Good legibility at small sizes.

variants.primary: bg-[#D5A528] text-black font-semibold hover:bg-[#E7C873] transition-all shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(213,165,40,0.3)]
variants.outline: border border-[#D5A528] text-[#D5A528] hover:bg-[#D5A528] hover:text-black transition-all

Input.style: bg-transparent border-b border-[#333] focus:border-[#D5A528] rounded-none px-0 py-4 text-white placeholder:text-zinc-600 focus:outline-none transition-colors

Card.style: bg-[#09090b] border border-[#27272a] hover:border-[#D5A528]/50 transition-colors duration-500 rounded-xl overflow-hidden

layout_strategies.hero_section: Typographic focus. Large 'Outfit' headline with Gold Gradient. Background: Deep black with subtle SVG gold geometric lines (opacity 10%). CTA: Primary Gold Button.
layout_strategies.supply_section: Bento Grid layout. Dark cards with product images. Hover effect: Card border glows gold. Images should 'float'.
layout_strategies.process_section: Horizontal timeline. Steps (1, 2, 3) in gold circles. Connecting lines animate or are solid gold.
layout_strategies.footprint_section: Use 'react-simple-maps'. Dark map (fill: #1a1a1a). Markers: Gold pulsing dots (fill: #D5A528). Locations: Ireland, UAE, USA.
layout_strategies.admin_dashboard: Sidebar layout. Clean data table for enquiries. High contrast. Status badges (New, Contacted, Closed).

tech_stack_instructions.animation: Use 'framer-motion'. Entrance: `initial={{opacity: 0, y: 20}} whileInView={{opacity: 1, y: 0}}`. Stagger children.
tech_stack_instructions.maps: Install 'react-simple-maps' and 'd3-scale' if needed for the footprint section. Do NOT use Google Maps API.

universal_guidelines: NEVER use pure white (#FFFFFF) backgrounds. Always #000000 or #09090b.
Gold text must be legible. If background is black, Gold #D5A528 is fine. If text is small, use lighter Gold #E7C873.
Avoid 'Standard Bootstrap' column layouts. Use asymmetric grids.
All interactive elements must have a :hover state.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and inputs.
Do not use generic 'Inter' font. Use 'Outfit' for headings.
Use plenty of negative space (padding-y-24 or 32).
